documentRules: Proof of accommodation covering the full stay is expected unless a host invitation letter is provided.
Bank statements should demonstrate sufficient balance for the full stay and transport costs.
Travel medical insurance must cover all Schengen states with at least EUR 30,000 coverage.
Applicants should evidence daily maintenance funds for each day of the planned stay.
Accommodation proof may be hotel bookings or a host invitation letter accepted by the consulate.
Proof of onward or return travel is typically reviewed during visa adjudication.
Applicants should provide clear itinerary evidence and means of subsistence for the complete stay.
Hosted travel should include a host letter and address details aligned with the application form.
Employment or business travelers should attach employer confirmation and leave approval when relevant.
